title: Fix WebSocketBridge _ws data race (P0 from 10-agent audit)
description: P0 finding from 2026-07-11 audit: _ws is mutated without synchronization in WebSocketBridge.cs. SendAsync reads _ws to check IsOpen while the reconnect loop disposes and replaces _ws. No lock — send can race with reconnect. Guard _ws access with a lock or use ImmutableInterlocked for atomic swap. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md (P0-002)
